title: The Chemical Brothers · Let Forever Be
description: A bedside clock, department-store escalators and repeated dancers turn an ordinary morning into a patterned stage revue.

performance.lyrics: What? Ah What? Ah Ah Now does it feel like to wake up in the sun? How does it feel like to shout out everyone? Ah How does it feel like to live forever free? Ah And how does it feel like To spend a little time sitting in the gutter Ah And Ah Ah How does it feel like to stay alone, Ah And how does it feel like to spend a little lifetime sitting in the car? Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah How does it feel like to make it happen to me? and how does it feel like to breathe with everything? Ah And how does it feel like to live forever free? And how does it feel like to spend a little time sitting in gutter, Ah scream out simply Ah How does it feel like to be a christening Ah How does it feel like to spend a little lifetime sitting in the gutter Ah I'd scream out the sound of the rain Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah
